title: My Reflection Moved Half a Second Late #shorts #scarystories
description:
My brother knew something I didn't: which side my scar is on.

Follow for new scary stories every day.

#scarystory #horrorstories #creepy #shorts

beats.text: Last night my reflection smiled. I wasn't smiling.
A storm cut the power. I brushed my teeth by candlelight.
Same pajamas, same scar. But it moved half a second late.
I blamed the candle and went to bed.
At three, I heard the bathroom tap running.
The mirror was fogged over. Something had written in the steam.

overlay.message: Coming now. Stay out of the bathroom.

beats.text: He ran through the rain, and I opened the door.
He looked at me. Then he stepped back.
He said, my sister's scar is on her left cheek.
I touched my face. Mine was on the right.
Down the hall, something pounded on glass.
Behind the mirror, a girl in my pajamas screamed his name.
Sam pressed his hand to the glass. She pressed hers back.
So I blew out the candle.
In the dark, he can't tell which one of us is real.
And I'm the one on his side of the glass.
